propositions: Consolidate all structured-output consumers (library, CLI, MCP, in-tree callers) to use the single one-operation bounded-Pydantic path through the PydanticAIRunner facade instead of bespoke retry loops
Remove obsolete manual retry machinery and compatibility delegation while preserving the structured_retry_limit knob as an output-retry-allowance cap
Retain structured_retry_limit=0 single-shot fail-safe: zero output-repair retries and zero request-limit addend for overlap/judge and contracts batch abstain
Seed the Agent retries={"output":N} and constructed UsageLimits request_limit addend from a single allowance N to guarantee the request budget cannot trip before the output-retry counter
In-Agent output repair (ModelRetry within one agent.run_sync) replaces bespoke Python retry loops so a bounded retry adds one model request without a second run_sync call
